title: 卡莉丝塔·青影长堤
description: 青蓝卡莉丝塔穿完整甲胄站在宽阔石堤，长矛枪尾落地静持，身体没有穿刺武器，冷光与金色天际分开轮廓。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Kalista is a spectral adult warrior woman with cool blue-green skin, long dark hair, a pointed armored headpiece, luminous eyes, and angular dark armor. Preserve her lean natural adult form with fully covered torso, legs, and feet. Her long spear rests grounded at her side; do not depict spears piercing her body, open wounds, exposed remains, or frightening spectral distortion.
art_direction.scene: She stands on a broad empty stone causeway above calm water, one hand holding the vertical grounded spear and the other relaxed near her hip. Her head turns toward a distant arched gate. Hard blue side light and a thin warm horizon create strong wax-crayon armor facets, with wide clean atmospheric layers making the ghostly identity dignified rather than ominous.
art_direction.palette: cool teal, deep navy, pale silver, amber horizon
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
